[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
'''Johne Glasgow''' was recorded at Duddingston on '''4 April 1639''', with parents '''Johne Glasgow''' and '''Margaret Sluman'''. He is attached to [[Glasgow-1088|Johne Glasgow]] and [[Sluman-45|Margaret Sluman]].<ref name="John1639">[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1TP-WYF FamilySearch], indexed Duddingston child record; the source citation on this profile reads MARGARET SLUMAN, Duddingston, 1639, and JOHNE, 04-04-1639, JOHNE GLASGOW/MARGARET SLUMAN, FR48, parish 684. Original image not inspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
He is a possible match for '''Jon Glasgow''' in the Duddingston deaths and burials index on '''23 August 1641''', parish 684, reference 60/24. The other-details field reads '''JON GLASGOW''', but the index gives neither age nor an explicit kin term.<ref name="Jon1641">National Records of Scotland, Old Parish Registers, deaths and burials, Duddingston, parish 684, reference 60/24, 23 August 1641, JON GLASGOW, Parents/Other details JON GLASGOW, age blank, gender M; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Scotland's People], exact-surname Glasgow search to 1700, index extract supplied 10 September 2026. Original image not inspected.</ref>

[[Glasgow-3014|John Glasgow]], recorded in the same parish in January 1638, is another chronological candidate. That child also has a probable, unproved match to a January 1638 deaths-and-burials entry. The originals must distinguish the two children before the 1641 event is assigned to either. This 1639 child cannot be the subject of the earlier 1638 event. No exact death date is established here.

A possible identification concerns Jon Glasgow, Duddingston burial index, 1641. ScotlandsPeople's Church of Scotland Old Parish Registers deaths-and-burials index contains a Duddingston entry dated 23 August 1641 for '''Jon''', with other indexed detail '''Jon Glasgow''' (parish 684, reference 60/24).<ref>Church of Scotland, Old Parish Registers, deaths and burials, Duddingston, JON, other indexed detail JON GLASGOW, 23 August 1641, parish 684, reference 60/24, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] index; exact-Glasgow results through 1700 supplied 10 September 2026. The original register image has not been inspected.</ref>

The index does not state an age, residence, parent, spouse, occupation or cause. Its other-name field is preserved as indexed and does not establish a father or any other relationship. Whether the date denotes death, burial or another burial-related entry remains unresolved.

Two existing Duddingston children are possible matches: [[Glasgow-1559|John Glasgow]], recorded born 4 April 1639 to John Glasgow and Margaret Sluman, and [[Glasgow-3014|John Glasgow]], recorded born 11 January 1638 to John Glasgow and Helen Patoune. The name, parish and chronology do not distinguish them. The identification remains uncertain.
